question: Viral suppression on ART (HIV RNA < 1000 copies/mL) requires at least 95% medication adherence, meaning no more than one missed dose per month for a once-daily regimen.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The 95% threshold is clinically significant: ≥ 95% adherence sustains suppression and prevents resistance. Counselling sessions should use concrete tools (pill count, treatment partners, medication diaries) to achieve this.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Studies show that ≥ 95% adherence is required for sustained viral suppression. For a once-daily regimen (e.g., TLD), this means missing no more than approximately 1–2 doses per month. Sub-95% adherence leads to detectable viraemia and risks accumulation of drug resistance mutations.
